description: This PHP class defines a validation rule for review reviewer ratings within the OrangeHRM Performance module. It checks that the input ratings conform to expected structure and value constraints, including KPI IDs and rating ranges.

classes.name: ReviewReviewerRatingParamRule
classes.description: A validation rule class that verifies the structure and values of reviewer ratings for performance review KPIs.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the rule with a specific review ID.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the given ratings array to ensure it meets all required constraints, such as KPI ID validity and rating ranges.
